# MongoDB MQL query optimization concept family

> Eight source-anchored concept packs covering MongoDB MQL query optimization: explain plans and the query planner, compound index design, wildcard/hidden indexes and index builds, query-shape optimization, time-series query optimization, query-optimization tooling, advanced explain and the 8.3 cost-based ranker, and Atlas slow-query/advisor automation. Built 2026-10-19 by an automated research pipeline; page counts are cited source documents, not site coverage; private derived navigation over MongoDB documentation, never published. A pack that was split lists its child packs under '## Child packs' in its own llms.txt; pages inside a child pack are three hops from this file, an exception to the two-hop rule below that applied to the time-series and query-optimization-tooling packs at generation time.
